title: When Can Conformal Risk Control Certify LLM Outputs? Bounds, Impossibility, and Adaptation for Structured Generation
abstract: arXiv:2606.29054v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) deployed for structured generation (NER, JSON extraction, QA, and classification) lack formal reliability guarantees, and standard heuristic abstention policies violate user-specified risk targets on 7.5--12.5% of settings, with no per-deployment guarantee. We characterize when conformal risk control (CRC) can certify structured LLM outputs and when it provably cannot. First, we prove a sharpened, attained feasibility frontier: when base risk \mu exceeds target \alpha, any distribution-free method must abstain on at least (\mu-\alpha)/(M-\alpha) of inputs, yielding a closed-form feasibility test that decides whether CRC can work before running it. Second, we establish a proven certification phase diagram across Hoeffding, empirical Bernstein, and a betting-based e-CRC bound, verified over 716 configurations (six open-weight models 3B--72B, eight datasets, six scores): at strict targets (\alpha <= 0.20) th

translated_title: 保形风险控制何时能够认证大语言模型的输出？结构化生成的边界、不可能性与自适应方法
translated_abstract: 部署用于结构化生成任务（命名实体识别、JSON提取、问答和分类）的大语言模型（LLM）缺乏形式化的可靠性保证，而标准的启发式弃权策略在7.5%至12.5%的设置中会违反用户指定的风险目标，且无法提供针对每次部署的保证。我们刻画了保形风险控制（CRC）何时能够认证结构化的LLM输出，以及何时在理论上可以证明其无法做到。首先，我们证明了一个更精细且可达到的可行性前沿：当基础风险μ超过目标风险α时，任何无分布方法必须至少在(μ-α)/(M-α)比例的输入上弃权，由此得到一个闭式形式的可行性测试，可在运行CRC之前判定其是否可行。其次，我们建立了一个经过验证的认证相图，涵盖Hoeffding、经验Bernstein以及基于投注的e-CRC三种边界方法，并在716种配置（六个3B至72B的开源权重模型、八个数据集、六种评分函数）上进行了验证：在严格目标（α≤0.20）下……
tldr: 该论文刻画了保形风险控制认证LLM结构化输出的可行边界，证明了当基础风险超过目标时任何无分布方法的最小弃权率下界，给出了闭式可行性测试，并通过716种配置验证了认证相图与自适应方法。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes when conformal risk control can certify structured LLM outputs, proving a sharp lower bound on the required abstention rate when base risk exceeds the target, deriving a closed-form feasibility test, and validating certification phase diagrams with adaptation strategies across 716 configurations.
